links.outcome: AI VTE risk classification sensitivity/specificity versus clinician order sets against physician-adjudicated reference standard
links.effect: iHGR 81.8% sensitivity, 70.9% specificity; checklist order set 61.3% sensitivity, 86.2% specificity; clinician judgement order set 78.1% sensitivity, 65.4% specificity.
links.quote: iHGR showed higher sensitivity for VTE risk than checklist-based order sets and clinician judgement without introducing systematic bias.

links.outcome: Presence of systematic bias in AI VTE risk classification
links.effect: Authors report higher sensitivity than order sets without introducing systematic bias; no subgroup numbers given in abstract.
links.quote: iHGR showed higher sensitivity for VTE risk than checklist-based order sets and clinician judgement without introducing systematic bias.
